description:
Symptom: workflow run 25019454000 on commit 608e799 — all 233 tests pass, then cargo-tarpaulin exits with `Error: "Test failed during run"` (exit 1), and `make coverage` fails with exit 2. CI badge is red.

Diagnosis: the Makefile coverage target runs `cargo tarpaulin ... --engine llvm ...`. The llvm engine relies on Rust's source-based coverage (`-C instrument-coverage`), which needs the `llvm-tools-preview` rustup component to provide `llvm-profdata` / `llvm-cov`. The current workflow's `dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable` step (.github/workflows/ci.yml line 14-18) only installs `rustfmt, clippy` — `llvm-tools-preview` is missing, so tarpaulin's llvm engine can't link the profiling runtime and bails despite all tests passing.

Fix: add `llvm-tools-preview` to the toolchain components list. Confirm by re-running the workflow and observing a green run. If still red, fall back to the ptrace engine (drop `--engine llvm` from the Makefile coverage target — but that path was deliberately chosen per tarpaulin.toml's notes about ptrace racing the bash-tool cascade tests, so prefer the toolchain fix).

Reproduce: `gh run view 25019454000 -R mudbungie/lernie --log-failed | tail -10` shows the failing tail.

Gates (per CLAUDE.md):
- tests: workflow run on the merge commit must complete green
- docs: no doc change needed unless engine choice changes
- alignment: keep the 100% coverage gate intact; don't lower the floor as a workaround

Hand off to whoever owns CI (Reflex).
title: CI: fix tarpaulin coverage failure on GitHub runner
